note: Maintainer-controlled register for the exact declared expressions in package-lock.json. Prepared by the coding agent, with independent technical review required before merge; no human or legal sign-off is claimed. The tool never edits this register. A reviewed status records technical examination of declared terms and outstanding distribution obligations, not legal compatibility or proof of ownership.

0BSD.note: Public-domain-equivalent terms; no attribution condition. Keep the license text with distributed source.

Apache-2.0.note: Permissive with patent grant. Keep copyright and license texts, carry any NOTICE text, and state modifications in changed files.

Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later.note: Conjunctive expression: both sets of terms apply. The LGPL parts are prebuilt native code (see docs/dependency-licenses.md) and carry the LGPL notice, relinking and source obligations; Apache terms are not an alternative to them.

Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later AND MIT.note: Conjunctive expression: all three sets of terms apply. See docs/dependency-licenses.md for the bundled wasm/native parts and their LGPL obligations.

BSD-2-Clause.note: Permissive; keep copyright and license text with distributions.

BSD-3-Clause.note: Permissive; keep copyright and license text, and do not use contributor names for endorsement.

BlueOak-1.0.0.note: Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0, permissive; keep the license text with distributions.

ISC.note: Permissive; keep the copyright and permission notice.

LGPL-3.0-or-later.note: Weak copyleft for libraries. Prebuilt binaries in this tree (sharp/libvips packages) require keeping notices, enabling user modification/relinking or providing corresponding source; unresolved bundled-binary obligations are listed in docs/dependency-licenses.md.

MIT.note: Permissive; keep the copyright and permission notice in copies of the material.

MIT-0.note: MIT-0 (MIT No Attribution), permissive without an attribution condition; keep the license text.

MPL-2.0.note: Mozilla Public License 2.0: file-level copyleft. Covered source files must stay available, modifications stay under MPL-2.0, and license notices must be kept. See docs/dependency-licenses.md for the LibreOffice Kit packages and their source-availability questions.

Python-2.0.note: Python Software Foundation License 2.0, permissive; keep the license text and any retained copyright.

(MIT AND Zlib).note: Conjunctive expression: both the MIT and Zlib terms apply to the pako copies under pdf-lib; keep both notices. Not a choice between the two.

(MIT OR CC0-1.0).note: Disjunctive expression: the licensee may choose MIT or CC0-1.0 for type-fest. Keep the exact expression; do not collapse it to one license or treat both as cumulative conditions.
